title: Daily English: 点餐·购物·问路
story: 想象你在国外旅行：饿了要点餐·想买纪念品·迷路要问路——课本上的"Is this a pen?"帮不了你。这一课教三个最实用的日常场景——学完就能开口用。
aiIntro: 🍔 出国也不怕——实用场景英语！

blocks.title: 点餐四句
items: Could I have a cheeseburger and fries, please?（请给我一个芝士汉堡和薯条）——加 please 是礼貌
For here or to go?（在这儿吃还是带走？）——店员会问你
For here, please. / To go, please.
Anything else? No, thanks. That is all.（还要别的吗？不了谢谢）——收尾

blocks.title: 加一句
blocks.text: Could I get some water, please?（可以给我一些水吗？）——免费的水在大部分餐厅可以要：渴了别忍着
Could I have... please? = 万能点餐句

items.label: 问价
items.value: How much is this? / How much are these?（这个/这些多少钱？）——最简单最万能

items.label: 试穿
items.value: Can I try this on?（我可以试试吗？）——买衣服必问

items.label: 决定
items.value: I will take it.（我要买它）/ I am just looking.（我只是看看）——买或不买都礼貌

blocks.title: 付钱
blocks.text: Do you take credit cards?（可以刷卡吗？）/ Cash, please.（现金）——国外的支付方式跟国内不同·提前问清楚
How much + I will take it = 购物闭环

blocks.title: 问路三句
items: Excuse me, how can I get to the train station?（打扰一下·怎样到火车站？）——Excuse me 开头是礼貌
Is it far from here?（离这里远吗？）/ How long does it take to walk?（走路要多久？）
Thank you so much! / Thanks for your help!（非常感谢）——问完一定说谢谢

blocks.title: 听懂回答
blocks.text: Go straight.（直走）/ Turn left.（左转）/ Turn right.（右转）/ It is next to the bank.（在银行旁边）——四个方向词+两个方位词就能听懂大部分指路

blocks.title: 兜底策略
blocks.text: Could you show me on the map?（能在地图上指给我看吗？）——听不懂没关系·打开手机地图让对方指：万无一失
Excuse me + How can I get to... + Thank you = 问路三件套

sections.title: 点餐用语
sections.body:
【万能】Could I have... please?
【问答】For here or to go?
【结尾】That is all. Thanks.

sections.title: 购物用语
sections.body:
【问价】How much is/are...?
【试穿】Can I try it on?
【决定】I will take it. / Just looking.

sections.title: 问路用语
sections.body:
【开头】Excuse me...
【核心】How can I get to...?
【听懂】straight/left/right/next to。
【兜底】Show me on the map.

examples.q: 在麦当劳想点一个汉堡和可乐
steps: Could I have a burger and a Coke, please?

examples.q: 在国外迷路了找不到酒店
steps: Excuse me, how can I get to the hotel?
听不懂→Could you show me on the map?

mistakes: 直接说"Give me..."（不礼貌——用 Could I have... please?）
问完路不说谢谢（Thank you 是必须的）

options: Could I have a burger, please?

exercises.q: "For here or to go?"的意思是？
听不懂对方指路怎么办？
options: 你能不能在地图上面指一指
